notes.title: 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
- 2025 Season 2 begins!

- Campaign mercenary selection (2 types) upon clearing all campaigns?!

- New mercenary "Tax Collector" added!

- New card "Lobster Monster", "Broken Token" added!

- Higher-level achievements added

- Ranked point system reworked

- Daily ranking expanded to top 25 players

- Main menu redesigned

- Fixed an issue where only carrots were consumed and the card wasn't obtained when purchasing with golden carrots under certain conditions

- Fixed an issue where reconnection could fail under certain conditions

- Fixed an issue where Gorani’s congratulatory sound in the result screen was not affected by volume settings

- Fixed a visual issue where scarecrows that change area score appeared to activate even when removed (they did not activate on the server)
